cohort: 534 deliveries between 220/7 and 296/7 gestational weeks, from January 2008 through December 2015, at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology of the University Hospital in Ulm, Germany
finding: While NEC, ROP, and long-term neurological outcomes did not appear to be affected by shorter ACS intervals, BPD, IVH, and surfactant administration were more common with ACS <24 hours.
